en.title: Claimed to have conducted shooting practice before attack
en.summary: A 15-year-old who caused violence at a school had obtained ammunition from a hunting supplier one month earlier after participating in shooting practice.

stories.title: Teğmenler: Bizi ihraç edenlere ödül verildi

en.title: Lieutenants: Those who dismissed us were rewarded
en.summary: Military officers testified regarding a disciplinary complaint, stating that those who voted against them received promotions while supporters faced dismissal or exile.

en.title: Journalist detained after AKP deputy's speech
en.summary: A journalist and spouse were detained after publishing statements by a Diyarbakır deputy that praised a terrorist leader.

en.title: Adalar Municipality joins AKP after 17 years
en.summary: The Adalar Municipality, previously controlled by the opposition CHP, changed hands to the ruling AKP party following a closely contested local election.

en.title: How is the opposition viewing Mansur Yavaş's resignation?
en.summary: The leader of the İYİ Party commented on Mansur Yavaş's resignation, characterizing his political stance with a phrase about maintaining unity from the grassroots level.

stories.title: Özgür Özel: Tarihin doğru tarafında durdu

en.title: Özgür Özel: He stood on the right side of history
en.summary: The leader of the Yeni Party stated that Mansur Yavaş took a principled position by objecting to a controversial political arrangement.

en.title: The stakes have disappeared
en.summary: During a two-year restoration project, approximately 80 percent of the wooden stakes in a structure's foundation were found to be missing, affecting its reopening timeline.

en.title: Mehmet Çakmak arrested after creating AI-manipulated photo with Erdoğan and Gürlek
en.summary: A person was arrested for sharing an artificial intelligence-generated image that placed him alongside Erdoğan and another official.

en.title: Ministry admits: We couldn't inspect hotels because they weren't our vehicles
en.summary: The Tourism Ministry failed to prepare annual inspection programs and had not checked some facilities for five years.

en.title: Serious tunnel accident: 1 dead, 2 injured
en.summary: A collision involving a minivan and two trucks in the T-26 tunnel on the Artvin-Erzurum highway in Yusufeli district resulted in one Iranian truck driver's death and two injuries.

en.summary: A multi-vehicle collision involving a truck and a pickup occurred in a tunnel in Yusufeli district of Artvin, resulting in one death and two injuries.

en.title: Claude scanned DNA with 950 agents in 21 hours: Found previously unidentified system
en.summary: Anthropic's approximately 950 Claude agents scanned a large DNA database and identified a new biological system by examining over 200,000 enzymes.

en.title: Meta's artificial intelligence glasses coming to Turkey
en.summary: Meta announced it will sell artificial intelligence glasses developed with Ray-Ban and Oakley in Turkey before year-end, featuring live translation and 3K video capabilities.

en.title: Interest rate barrier to gold: Market pricing in new increase
en.summary: Strong US economic growth signals pushed bond yields above 5 percent and pressured gold below 4,300 dollars. The market is weighing whether safe-haven demand or interest rate returns will dominate gold price movements.

en.title: UN Security Council alarm on artificial intelligence: Call for global regulation from company executives
en.summary: The CEOs of OpenAI and Anthropic addressed the UN Security Council about risks of artificial intelligence misuse and loss of control, calling for global collaboration and shared standards to ensure safe technology development.

en.title: Erdoğan: We must establish strong links between climate targets and development and prosperity
en.summary: President Erdoğan stated that climate goals must align with social and economic realities, noting that countries cannot advance at the same pace while inequalities in financing and technology access persist.
